description: Independent guide to hot tub lodges, cabins and glamping in Wales. Where to stay, when to book, and what the listing photos don't tell you.
_comment_affiliate: Replace PENDING with your real tracking link once your affiliate application is approved. The build script drops these into every Browse button. Until then the buttons point at the plain public search URL, which is honest and still works.

author.name: Dylan
author.bio: I live in mid Wales and I've spent a lot of weekends in the places on this site. Everything here is written by hand, not scraped.
